annotations.title: What a funded account is likely to pay

description: For up to five accounts: the chance of getting funded, then what the funded account does over its first six months (126 trading days): payouts on average, money to the trader after the split, how soon the first payout comes, how many funded accounts are lost, and what one attempt is worth counting those payouts. Each payout follows the account's rules; after a payout the profit comes out and the account carries on from its starting balance. Give trades with starting_balance, or the four headline numbers.

reward_to_risk.description: Average win divided by average loss, for example 2 for a 1:2 strategy.

risk_per_trade.description: Percentage of the account lost on a losing trade, for example 1.

starting_balance.description: Needed with trades: the balance the trades started from.

trades.description: Closed trades in the order they closed.

date.description: Close date, YYYY-MM-DD. Give it for every trade or for none.

profit.description: Profit (positive) or loss (negative) in account currency, after costs.

trades_per_day.description: Average trades per trading day, for example 1.5.

win_rate.description: Percentage of trades that win, for example 45.

name: funded_life
